It's the same problem as #29 but nobody picked that up, so create it anyway and mention #29. Only threads that already exist; channel messages can keep being merged.

1. Answer each message in an existing thread

## Summary
Messages in a thread the bot already answers are joined into one turn by the burst window. Each one should get its own reply, as #29 also reports.

## Current behaviour
Quick messages in an existing thread wait out the burst window and are answered once, as `Name: text` lines.

## Desired behaviour
Every message in an existing thread gets its own reply. Channel messages outside threads are still joined within the burst window.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Two quick messages in an existing thread get two replies
- [ ] Two quick messages in a channel still get one reply
- [ ] Direct messages keep one reply per message *(added)*

## Out of scope
- Changing the burst window length

---
